observations: Black mirrorless camera with 'LUMIX' branding on the top plate.
The camera body is equipped with a 15-120mm lens.
A built-in electronic viewfinder (EVF) is visible on the top of the camera body.
A silver charging cable is visible on the right side of the camera body.
A battery and a charger are visible next to the camera in photo 1.
The camera is resting on a blue textured surface.
A watermark 'TYANUOLUWA PETER' is present on both images.

claims.evidence: The exterior appears clean, but the interior of the body and the lens glass are not shown.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or the EVF may not function.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on and the EVF displaying a live view.

risks.risk: The shutter count may be high, indicating significant use.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent photo or a diagnostic tool.

risks.risk: The lens may have fungus, scratches, or internal damage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the battery powering the camera for at least 10 minutes.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
A photo of the camera's LCD screen while powered on.
A photo of the shutter count label on the camera body.
A video showing the camera powering on and the EVF working.
A photo of the lens glass to check for fungus or scratches.
A photo of the battery and charger to confirm they are original.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
